dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6b Environmentally Sensitive Significant Area.

Environmentally Sensitive Significant Areas are lands recognized for their exceptional ecological value due to unique biological, geological, hydrological, or landscape characteristics. These areas warrant enhanced protection to preserve their environmental functions and natural heritage significance.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
